ceu: ✦ The square between the Sun and Uranus

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between friendships and money. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between your career and your image. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between relationships and your career. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between routine and your horizons. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between romance and intimacy. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between family and relationships. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between conversations and routine. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between money and romance. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between your image and family. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.
